title: Meja Bulat Cikgu Pencen
subject: three retired school teachers, Malay, Chinese and Indian, arguing over the newspaper crossword at the same round kopitiam table every morning
caption: Malaysian multi-ethnic folk fusion in the style of the 2025 National Day theme that weaves folk instruments from several communities. A gambus lute plucking quick ornamented lines; an erhu answering with sliding phrases; a tabla playing a light rolling groove under a rebana ubi frame drum on the downbeats; a strummed nylon-string guitar holding the chords; a unison male group vocal on the chorus. Organic and bright, a live room sound, gambus and erhu trading phrases left and right. Male voice, warm storytelling baritone, conversational verses, three voices together on the chorus. 108 BPM, G major. Warm, wry and lively. No patriotic anthem build, no orchestral swell, no trap beat, no autotune, no synth pads, no sape.
lyrics:
[Intro - gambus, erhu and tabla]

[Verse 1]
Pukul tujuh, kopitiam Ah Seng di simpang
Cikgu Kassim bawa pen merah dari rumah
Cikgu Lim pegang suratkhabar, Cikgu Muthu pesan teh halia
Masing-masing tiga puluh tahun mengajar

[Pre-Chorus]
Empat menurun, tujuh huruf
Dah setengah jam masih bertengkar

[Chorus]
Meja bulat cikgu pencen
Teh dah sejuk, roti bakar keras
Silang kata belum habis
Esok pagi kita sambung lagi

[Verse 2]
Cikgu Muthu kata jawapan dia betul
Cikgu Lim kata dia dulu ajar Bahasa
Cikgu Kassim ketuk meja, cucu Ah Seng tolong semak
Budak tu cari dalam telefon, semua diam sekejap

[Pre-Chorus]
Telefon tu tipu, kata tiga cikgu
Kertas ni tak boleh menipu

[Chorus]
Meja bulat cikgu pencen
Teh dah sejuk, roti bakar keras
Silang kata tak pernah siap
Tapi tiga kerusi tak pernah kosong

[Outro - gambus and erhu]
Esok, pukul tujuh
Pen merah jangan lupa
